purpose: Lead-quality filter for the ANALYST alert digest: a report whose title or summary contains one of these terms is never promoted as a theatre lead. The report itself stays in the feed with its original, unaltered text (attributed to its channel); only the server-chosen lead skips it.
source: Curated from Wikipedia, 'List of ethnic slurs' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ethnic_slurs, CC BY-SA 4.0) and 'List of ethnic slurs by ethnicity', restricted to unambiguous slurs and hate terms likely in English, Russian and Ukrainian OSINT channels. Terms that are also ordinary words or common surnames (e.g. 'chink' in 'chink in the armour', the surname Moskalenko) are matched as whole words only or left out.
match: Case-insensitive. 'word': the whole word, optionally with a plural/case ending listed in 'endings'. 'prefix': any word starting with the term.
